title: Very cheap!
text: Very cheap!. Basic fiber wood frame with a fake-wood-painted veneer paper on top - some already scratched just getting them out of the box! Glass is low quality with wavy streaks that won’t polish clean and has raw edges that cut your skin! Also the support stand lays against the frame instead of inside it so it hangs crooked and not flat against the wall if you hang it! I expected some basic frames for this price but these are worse than expected, especially when better ones are available for about the same price. NOT recommended!!
